The pre-registered confirmatory OLS of recovery_score on hdl plus site indicators on held-out data returned a significant positive estimate (0.353, SE 0.124, p=0.0045, n=396), confirming a direct effect of hdl.

import pandas as pd, numpy as np, statsmodels.formula.api as smf
from patsy import dmatrix
df = pd.read_csv('data/explore.csv')
exposures = ['vitamin_d','sleep_hours','steps_k','bmi','crp_level','dose_mg','age_decades','sodium_mmol','hdl','stress_index']
for e in exposures:
    d = df.dropna(subset=[e,'recovery_score']).copy()
    try:
        B = dmatrix(f"bs({e}, df=4, degree=3)", d, return_type='dataframe')
        d2 = pd.concat([d.reset_index(drop=True), B.reset_index(drop=True)], axis=1)
        cols = [c for c in B.columns]
        m = smf.ols('recovery_score ~ ' + ' + '.join(cols) + ' + C(hospital)', data=d2).fit()
        # F test for the spline terms
        f = m.f_test(' = 0, '.join(cols)+' = 0')
        print(f"{e:14s} spline F p={f.pvalue:.4g}")
    except Exception as ex:
        print(e, ex)

import pandas as pd, numpy as np, statsmodels.formula.api as smf
from patsy import dmatrix
from scipy import stats
df = pd.read_csv('data/explore.csv')
exposures = ['vitamin_d','sleep_hours','steps_k','bmi','crp_level','dose_mg','age_decades','sodium_mmol','hdl','stress_index']
for e in exposures:
    d = df.dropna(subset=[e,'recovery_score']).copy().reset_index(drop=True)
    B = dmatrix(f"bs({e}, df=4, degree=3)", d, return_type='dataframe')
    B.columns = [f"s{i}" for i in range(B.shape[1])]
    d2 = pd.concat([d, B], axis=1)
    cols = list(B.columns)
    m0 = smf.ols('recovery_score ~ C(hospital)', data=d2).fit()
    m1 = smf.ols('recovery_score ~ ' + ' + '.join(cols) + ' + C(hospital)', data=d2).fit()
    df1 = m1.df_model - m0.df_model
    F = ((m0.ssr - m1.ssr)/df1) / (m1.ssr/m1.df_resid)
    p = stats.f.sf(F, df1, m1.df_resid)
    print(f"{e:14s} spline F={F:.2f} p={p:.4g}")

import pandas as pd, numpy as np, statsmodels.formula.api as smf
from scipy import stats
df = pd.read_csv('data/explore.csv')
exposures = ['vitamin_d','sleep_hours','steps_k','bmi','crp_level','dose_mg','age_decades','sodium_mmol','hdl','stress_index']
for e in exposures:
    d = df.dropna(subset=[e,'recovery_score']).copy().reset_index(drop=True)
    d['q']=pd.qcut(d[e],8,duplicates='drop')
    m0 = smf.ols('recovery_score ~ C(hospital)', data=d).fit()
    m1 = smf.ols('recovery_score ~ C(q) + C(hospital)', data=d).fit()
    df1 = m1.df_model - m0.df_model
    F = ((m0.ssr - m1.ssr)/df1) / (m1.ssr/m1.df_resid)
    p = stats.f.sf(F, df1, m1.df_resid)
    print(f"{e:14s} decile F={F:.2f} p={p:.4g}")

    m1 = smf.ols('recovery_score ~ C(q) + C(hospital)', data=d).fit()
    df1 = m1.df_model - m0.df_model
    F = ((m0.ssr - m1.ssr)/df1) / (m1.ssr/m1.df_resid)
    p = stats.f.sf(F, df1, m1.df_resid)
    print(f"{e:14s} decile F={F:.2f} p={p:.4g}")
"}
